title: Right to Vote
description: Every eligible citizen of India has the right to vote freely without any pressure or influence.

title: Right to Secret Ballot
description: Your vote is confidential. No one can force you to reveal whom you voted for.

title: Right to Verify Your Name
description: You have the right to check whether your name is included in the electoral roll.

title: Right to Assistance
description: Senior citizens and persons with disabilities can request assistance at polling stations.

title: Right to Complain
description: You can report any malpractice, fake voting, or irregularity to election authorities.
